text.tspan: An agent generates, then exports a circular PNG
Local mode: the CLI runs the same core in-process against the shared library file, so the studio sees the result on its next refresh.
Resolve inputs; Random becomes a concrete color
export with format, size, circle, out
List and find the saved recipe
Next 5 s poll: GET /api/v1/collections makes the
The running service and the CLI share collections.jsonl;
each List re-reads it under a shared lock.
Toast “12 new portraits in your library”; cards
